what.text: This page follows refugees from Ethiopia living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 7494 Ethiopian refugees in Germany, 4.6% of all refugees from Ethiopia.
Sudan hosts the most Ethiopian refugees, followed by Kenya, Uganda and South Africa.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Ethiopia with the TPLF from 2020 to 2022, at war level in each of those years.
It also records armed conflicts over Oromiya territory in periods from 1998 to 2025 and over Ogaden territory from 1998 to 2016.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at its highest figure, 8134 refugees, and fell to a low in 2013.
It then rose again; the main years of displacement in the data are 2002 to 2005, 2009 to 2012 and 2017 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
